mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month indicates monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuation multiples and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals economic weakness, prompting Federal Reserve rate cuts that boost equity valuations and produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signal persistent inflationary pressures, leading to delayed monetary easing and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (indicated by high housing starts, HOUST > 1300), the market becomes overbought and vulnerable to corrections, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods (HOUST > 1300), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 4.0% (CPIAUCSL > 4.0) signals accelerating inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 4.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 1300) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance suppresses risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
